title: Choosing Your Base
caption:
Beauty Note — No. 03
Choosing Your Base

A base lives in between: after your skincare, before your foundation.
It is never a choice to make in isolation.

Consider your skin as it is today.
The humidity of the city you live in.
The look you have in mind, and the foundation you plan to wear.

A base is the bridge between them.
Choose it with the whole picture in view, never on its own.
